admin-redemptions.action.confirm.description: Label of an armed correction button: a second press saves. Reverts after a few seconds.

admin-redemptions.action.failed.description: Error line when a correction failed for a reason the server did not explain.

admin-redemptions.action.forbidden.defaultMessage: You no longer have permission to correct pickups.
admin-redemptions.action.forbidden.description: Toast when the operator's redemptions:write permission was withdrawn while the record was open.

admin-redemptions.action.mark.description: Records by hand that the item was handed over. The first press arms it and admin-redemptions.action.confirm replaces this label.

admin-redemptions.action.reason.description: Label of the reason choice beside a correction button.

admin-redemptions.action.reasonMissing.description: Error line when a correction is attempted without a reason.

admin-redemptions.action.reasonPlacehold.description: Empty first option of the reason choice.

admin-redemptions.action.resyncing.defaultMessage: The server took too long to respond. Reloading…
admin-redemptions.action.resyncing.description: Error line while the record reloads after a correction's answer timed out. The correction may or may not have been saved; the reloaded record shows which.

admin-redemptions.action.revert.description: Undoes a recorded collection, so the item shows as still to collect. The first press arms it and admin-redemptions.action.confirm replaces this label.

admin-redemptions.filter.item.description: Label of the item filter above the list.

admin-redemptions.filter.status.description: Label of the status filter above the list.

admin-redemptions.filter.status.all.description: Status filter value: everybody entitled to the item, collected or not.

admin-redemptions.filter.status.pending.description: Status filter value: entitled and not yet collected. The default.

admin-redemptions.history.actorKind.description: Small tag after the name in the history's Por column. Lowercase. other is only a fallback.

admin-redemptions.history.by.description: History column head: the volunteer or administrator who recorded it.

admin-redemptions.history.heading.description: Heading of the attendee's redemption history.

admin-redemptions.history.outcomeLabel.defaultMessage: {outcome, select, redeemed {Collected} duplicate {Repeat attempt} not_entitled {Not entitled} marked {Marked by admin} reverted {Reverted by admin} other {Record}}
admin-redemptions.history.outcomeLabel.description: What one history row records. redeemed: handed over at the counter or the T-shirt desk; duplicate: a second attempt at something already collected; not_entitled: an attempt at something the attendee never had; marked and reverted: an administrator's corrections. other is only a fallback.

admin-redemptions.history.reason.description: History column head: the reason given for a correction. Empty for a volunteer's own records and the T-shirt desk's.

admin-redemptions.history.truncated.defaultMessage: Showing the {count, number, ::group-off} most recent records.
admin-redemptions.history.truncated.description: Under the history when it was cut at its limit. {count} is the limit.

admin-redemptions.history.unknownActor.defaultMessage: {kind, select, admin {removed administrator} volunteer {removed volunteer} other {removed}}
admin-redemptions.history.unknownActor.description: Stands in for the name of a volunteer or administrator whose record no longer exists. other is only a fallback.

admin-redemptions.history.when.description: History column head: date and time.

admin-redemptions.list.clear.description: Resets every filter and the search.

admin-redemptions.list.code.description: Column head: the attendee's ticket code.

admin-redemptions.list.count.defaultMessage: {total, plural, =1 {{total, number, ::group-off} attendee} other {{total, number, ::group-off} attendees}}
admin-redemptions.list.count.description: Number of attendees matching the filters, above the list.

admin-redemptions.list.empty.defaultMessage: No records match the selected filters.
admin-redemptions.list.empty.description: The list is empty for the chosen filters.

admin-redemptions.list.heading.description: Heading of the per-attendee list under the filters.

admin-redemptions.list.option.description: Column head: the size or choice the attendee registered for.

admin-redemptions.list.pending.description: Status cell of an attendee who has not collected the item. Lowercase, as the pass chip reads.

admin-redemptions.list.redeemedAt.description: Status cell of an attendee who collected the item. {time} is the local date and time, already formatted.

admin-redemptions.list.status.description: Column head: collected, with the time, or still to collect.

admin-redemptions.page.title.description: Heading of the admin redemptions screen: what has been handed out, and to whom.

admin-redemptions.reason.misTap.description: Correction reason: the volunteer tapped the wrong item or tapped twice.

admin-redemptions.reason.offline.description: Correction reason: the item was handed over while the scanner or the connection was down.

admin-redemptions.reason.wrongAttendee.description: Correction reason: the item was recorded against somebody other than who received it.

admin-redemptions.record.archived.defaultMessage: This attendee is archived. Pickups can be viewed but not corrected.
admin-redemptions.record.archived.description: Banner on an archived attendee's record.

admin-redemptions.record.close.description: Accessible name of the record's close button.

admin-redemptions.record.edit.description: Opens the attendee's record form, where a size or choice can be changed.

admin-redemptions.record.items.description: Heading of the record's per-item list.

admin-redemptions.record.noItems.defaultMessage: This attendee has no items to collect.
admin-redemptions.record.noItems.description: The attendee is entitled to nothing.

admin-redemptions.record.pending.description: Status of an item the attendee has not collected.

admin-redemptions.record.readOnly.defaultMessage: You can view pickups but not correct them.
admin-redemptions.record.readOnly.description: Replaces the correction controls for an operator without the redemptions:write permission.

admin-redemptions.record.redeemedAt.description: Status of a collected item. {time} is the local date and time, already formatted.

admin-redemptions.state.stale.defaultMessage: Offline: the numbers may be out of date.
admin-redemptions.state.stale.description: Liveness line when refreshes have stopped landing.

admin-redemptions.state.updated.description: Liveness line of the totals. {time} is the local time of the last refresh, already formatted.

admin-redemptions.summary.expected.description: Column or figure label: how many active attendees are entitled to the item.

admin-redemptions.summary.heading.description: Heading of the per-item totals panel.

admin-redemptions.summary.item.description: Column head of the per-option breakdown: which item the option belongs to.

admin-redemptions.summary.none.defaultMessage: No attendee is entitled to this item.
admin-redemptions.summary.none.description: Shown in an item's card when no active attendee is entitled to it.

admin-redemptions.summary.option.description: Column head of the per-option breakdown: the size or choice.

admin-redemptions.summary.options.description: Heading of the per-option breakdown (t-shirt sizes, meal choices…), used to check stock at the counter.

admin-redemptions.summary.pendingAbsent.description: Column or figure label: entitled, not collected, and not checked in.

admin-redemptions.summary.pendingPresent.description: Column or figure label: entitled, not collected, and checked in — the people who can still come to the counter now.

admin-redemptions.summary.progress.description: Share of the entitled attendees who collected the item. {share} is a fraction between 0 and 1, formatted as a percentage.

admin-redemptions.summary.redeemed.description: Column or figure label: how many have collected the item.

admin-redemptions.summary.scope.description: Footnote under the totals: archived attendees are excluded from every figure.

admin-redemptions.toast.marked.description: Toast after an administrator marked an item as collected.

admin-redemptions.toast.reverted.description: Toast after an administrator undid a collection.
